# Whitney Stevenson
> B2B Event Marketing & Hospitality Leader, San Francisco

Whitney Stevenson is a San Francisco-based event and hospitality leader with 10+ years building B2B events for technology and entertainment brands. This site is her official portfolio: field notes on channel partnership building, trade-show production, experiential brand activation, and calm-under-pressure event operations.

## Pages

- [Home — Whitney Stevenson](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/)
- [Field Notes (blog index)](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/blog)

## Field Notes (articles)

- [How I Built Illumio's First LATAM Channel Partnership](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/blog/illumio-latam-channel-partnership) — Standing up Illumio's Latin America channel program (Brazil, São Paulo, Mexico) from zero: partner recruiting, market strategy, and what moved the targets in a region with no prior footprint.
- [The Target Run: Why I Don't Panic](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/blog/the-target-run) — A breakout speaker walked on stage with no screen; the essay on calm-under-pressure as a craft, not a personality trait.
- [Anchoring Arxan at Three Years of RSA Conference](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/blog/anchoring-arxan-three-years-rsa) — Three consecutive years running Arxan Technologies' presence at RSA Conference: booth fabrication, ROI tracking, and pipeline attribution.
- [What 300+ Tournaments at Presidio Golf Taught Me About Operations](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/blog/presidio-golf-300-tournaments) — Co-founding the women's club at Presidio Golf Course and producing 300+ tournaments over seven years.
- [PepsiCo Tostitos at Super Bowl 2026: Behind the Activation](https://www.whitneystevenson.com/blog/pepsico-tostitos-super-bowl-2026) — On-the-ground production for PepsiCo Tostitos at Super Bowl 2026, Pier 39 Fiesta Zone.
